description: fsl-tool 统筹已登记的独立方法和可复用流程。支持：FSL topup / eddy；FSL dtifit；FSL FLIRT；FSL 脑提取；FSL 组织分割；FSL 运动校正；FSL 层间时间校正；FSL 非线性配准；其他方法可在详情中分页查询。

method_refs.label: FSL topup / eddy
method_refs.default_reason: 当需要手动控制校正细节或已有 FSL 环境时更合适。
method_refs.role: 使用 FSL eddy_cpu 或 eddy_cuda 完成涡流、运动与离群值校正；topup 输出可以按需接入。

method_refs.label: FSL dtifit
method_refs.default_reason: 预处理已经采用 FSL 时可以减少工具切换。
method_refs.role: 复用 FSL 环境完成经典 DTI 张量拟合。

method_refs.label: FSL FLIRT
method_refs.default_reason: 适合常见的刚体或仿射线性配准，参数清晰且执行时间较短。
method_refs.role: 复用现有 FSL Skill 完成刚体或仿射线性配准，并输出变换矩阵。

method_refs.label: FSL 脑提取
method_refs.role: Extract brain tissue from the input image with FSL BET, controlling the fractional intensity threshold; save the extracted image and BET mask inside the result directory。 Inputs: input: 输入影像 (file). Registered outputs: results/image.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation bet.

method_refs.label: FSL 组织分割
method_refs.role: Segment the input brain image into the requested number of tissue classes with FSL FAST; expose the tissue segmentation and preserve additional FAST products in the result directory。 Inputs: input: 输入影像 (file). Registered outputs: results/tissue_seg.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation fast.

method_refs.label: FSL 运动校正
method_refs.role: Correct motion in a 4D image series with FSL MCFLIRT and save the corrected series, motion plots and transformation matrices。 Inputs: input: 输入影像 (file). Registered outputs: results/image.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation mcflirt.

method_refs.label: FSL 层间时间校正
method_refs.role: Correct slice acquisition timing in a 4D series with FSL slicetimer using the supplied repetition time, slice axis and acquisition order。 Inputs: input: 输入影像 (file). Registered outputs: results/image.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation slicetimer.

method_refs.label: FSL 非线性配准
method_refs.role: Register an input image nonlinearly to a reference with FSL FNIRT, optionally initialized by a supplied affine matrix; write the warped image and warp coefficients。 Inputs: input: 输入影像 (file); reference: 参考影像 (file); transform: 变换/形变场 (file). Registered outputs: results/image.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation fnirt.

method_refs.label: FSL 应用形变
method_refs.role: Apply an existing FSL warp to the input image on the supplied reference grid, using linear or nearest-neighbour interpolation. This entry does not estimate a new registration。 Inputs: input: 输入影像 (file); reference: 参考影像 (file); transform: 变换/形变场 (file). Registered outputs: results/image.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation applywarp.

method_refs.label: FSL 完整结构预处理（fsl_anat）
method_refs.role: Invoke the existing FSL fsl_anat workflow on a T1-weighted image and retain its structural.anat directory, including the bias-corrected brain image。 Inputs: input: T1w NIfTI (file). Registered outputs: results/structural.anat/T1_biascorr_brain.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation fsl-anat.

method_refs.label: FSL BEDPOSTX 纤维方向采样
method_refs.role: Run FSL BEDPOSTX on a staged copy of preprocessed DWI, a matching brain mask and FSL gradients; estimate fibre-orientation posterior samples. FSL subprocesses stay inside the allocated job。 Inputs: input: 预处理 DWI NIfTI (file); mask: 脑掩膜 (file); bval: bval (file); bvec: bvec (file). Registered outputs: results/data.bedpostX/merged_th1samples.nii.gz, results/data.bedpostX/merged_ph1samples.nii.gz, results/data.bedpostX/merged_f1samples.nii.gz. Fixed invocation options: --operation bedpostx.

method_refs.label: FSL ProbtrackX（已有方向采样，输出纤维密度图）
method_refs.role: Run FSL probtrackx2 from existing BEDPOSTX posterior samples with a brain mask and seed mask. Write path-density images and waytotal; it neither recomputes BEDPOSTX nor produces an MRtrix tractogram。 Inputs: samples: BEDPOSTX 结果目录 (directory); mask: 脑掩膜 (file); seed: 种子掩膜 (file). Registered outputs: results/fdt_paths.nii.gz, results/waytotal. Fixed invocation options: --operation probtrackx.

selection_rules: 已有变换时选择 applywarp，而不是重复估计配准。
eddy 使用既有 topup 结果时先检查场系数与采集参数；没有对应输入时不能把 topup 已完成当作事实。
分割、脑提取和配准是独立需求，不因选择 FSL 自动全部加入。
name: fsl-tool
applicability: 需要使用 FSL 方法，且具备对应影像、梯度、采集参数或变换文件。

examples.request: 把既有非线性变换应用到影像
examples.decision: 选择已接入的 applywarp，检查移动影像、参考影像及变换；不重新估计变换。
